integrity: The exact finite proof is supplied as a self-contained standard-library Python verifier; exact rational recurrence and independent permutation enumeration agree on every graph through five vertices. Independent external scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Minimality and marked-edge classification are proved only on connected graphs with at most five vertices. The all-time law pertains to the two identified augmentations. No stochastic dominance or thermodynamic-limit claim is made. The full text of a plausible 1989 precedent was unavailable; historical priority remains provisional.
title: Sharp five-site onset and a common kinetic crossover for hard-core monomer adsorption
